_comment: 関係節レベルの差し替え分(4組8枚)。対の2枚は前半の出来事(誰が誰に)が完全に同じで、後半の状態にある人物だけが違う。もう一方の人物は中立の表情・姿勢にする。画像を images/scene/<id>.png に生成・最適化したあと `node scripts/merge-pending.mjs` で取り込む。
prompt_template: {english_prompt}, simple scene illustration on a pure white background, flat illustration style. Style: clean, educational illustration for speech therapy materials; two characters, both clearly recognizable; the ongoing action between them is identical in both pictures of a pair, and it must be obvious at a glance which one of them is in the described state while the other looks neutral. Keep the same character designs across the paired pictures. Colors: soft, natural. Composition: only the characters and the objects needed for the scene, at most a thin ground line, no other background, no text, no speech bubbles, no logos. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
